what: AUD-20260927-CA-A15-closeall-leg-id-not-forwarded: src/units/ui/processor.py close_open_positions() (the /closeall operator command) always passes sl_order_id=None, tp_order_id=None to close_open_position() because (a) its SELECT (around line 1633) does not fetch the sl_order_id/tp_order_id columns, and (b) the ternary `row.get("sl_order_id") if hasattr(row, "get") else None` (around line 1722) always evaluates the else-branch because sqlite3.Row has no .get() method (hasattr always False). Result: a manual /closeall on a Bybit partial-TP/SL-mode account never cancels the position's resting qty-scoped legs, reproducing the bug class named in the code's own adjacent comment (BL-20260721-BYBIT2-XRP-TPSL-LEGCAP / BL-20260825-CLOSE-SIDE-LEG-CANCEL-IS-WIRED-AT-1-OF-10-CALL-SITES). The existing regression test tests/test_s031_pr4_closeall_helper.py only asserts the kwarg was passed, not that it carries the row's real value, and its fixture never seeds a non-null sl_order_id/tp_order_id, so it cannot catch this.
